files.eval_guideline: Diversity values per sample must match the reference within 0.1% relative absolute error; column order and header naming may differ.

column_configs.name: shannon

column_configs.name: gini
column_configs.reasoning: Gini-Simpson diversity is a required float64 output. Use a relative absolute error tolerance of 0.001 to enforce the explicit 0.1% requirement, including for values between zero and one.
